criteria.conditions: Node 22; synthetic sealed holdout; no external providers.
criteria.evidence_method: Run positive and known-bad threshold tests, then execute the integrated sealed holdout and inspect runner, report, verifier, and decision outputs.
criteria.target: Integrated sealed-holdout eval is >=97%; any lower result is FAIL and cannot promote.
criteria.validity_notes: Harness must reject a deliberately sub-threshold report and accept a contract-compliant report.

baseline.actual: Configured thresholds are 80%; recorded coverage was 87.46/87.99/89.55/81.86 with no critical or mutation proof.

criteria.conditions: Node 22; deterministic synthetic tests; mutation scope explicitly listed.
criteria.evidence_method: Run coverage with configured thresholds, critical-module aggregation, mutation guard, and known-bad reduced-threshold negatives.
criteria.target: Global statements/lines/functions >=90%, branches >=85%, critical-module branches >=95%, and selected mutation guard demonstrates 100%.
criteria.validity_notes: Threshold changes must be independently rejectable and cannot be hidden by exclusions.

baseline.actual: 20 files and 138 skipped tests had only a generic justification and no auditable denominator.

criteria.conditions: No real services; conditional tests remain explicit.
criteria.evidence_method: Generate the full skip inventory, compare it with allowlisted contracts and the PostgreSQL catalog, and run unknown/required-skip negative cases.
criteria.target: Every skipped file/test has ID, reason, owner, and dedicated gate; unknown or required skips fail certification.
criteria.validity_notes: The continuous worker integration test must be represented in the correct catalog or fail closed.

baseline.actual: Verifier accepted an anchor contained in a set of two shared digests.

criteria.conditions: Historical candidates remain immutable; new candidate identity is separate.
criteria.evidence_method: Run known-good identity cases and the anchor-plus-extra-digest negative case against the real verifier.
criteria.target: Phase 4A identity has exact cardinality and meaning; an anchor plus an extra shared digest fails.
criteria.validity_notes: Identity semantics must be exact rather than subset-based.

baseline.actual: PUBLIC was revoked without runtime grants; only exempt health was tested.

criteria.conditions: Disposable PostgreSQL only; no production database.
criteria.evidence_method: Disposable PostgreSQL role matrix, startup preflight, ordinary request, and missing-privilege negative tests.
criteria.target: The runtime role can execute an ordinary rate-limited request; missing table, grant, index, or preflight requirement fails startup and health does not mask it.
criteria.validity_notes: Must exercise the actual middleware and runtime role.

baseline.actual: Migration NOTICE-skipped uniqueness when duplicates existed; preflight did not require valid index semantics.

criteria.conditions: Synthetic disposable PostgreSQL; no destructive real data.
criteria.evidence_method: Apply migration to representative disposable duplicate and concurrent states, inspect index metadata, and verify retry/rollback behavior.
criteria.target: Legacy duplicates reconcile deterministically or block; required unique index validity/definition is enforced and concurrent upgrade converges.
criteria.validity_notes: Content and constraint evidence must be current for the exact candidate.

baseline.actual: Reconciler fabricated worker identity and correlation/policy metadata.

criteria.conditions: Synthetic approvals only; no sensitive actions.
criteria.evidence_method: Inject crash after decision and before audit, recover through the worker, then inspect the durable event and duplicate behavior.
criteria.source: approval store, reconciler, worker and audit event; A20-F08
criteria.target: Actor, reason, correlation, policy, payload hash, and command key survive decision/crash/recovery exactly once without worker fabrication.
criteria.validity_notes: The original causal narrative must be persisted before recovery.

baseline.actual: Commit and release filtered by key/status without fencing token.

criteria.evidence_method: Run interleaved memory and disposable PostgreSQL reserve/reclaim/commit/release scenarios with stale holders.
criteria.target: Every reservation has generation/token fencing; an old holder cannot commit or release a lease reclaimed by a newer holder.
criteria.validity_notes: Race evidence must inspect durable state and returned outcomes.

baseline.actual: Audit identified claim-before-auth and possible budget reset on active bucket eviction.

criteria.evidence_method: Run forged-token, valid-replay, cross-process, and active-bucket churn cases against the real store boundary.
criteria.source: token replay and distributed rate-limit paths; A20-F04
criteria.target: Signature is authenticated before distributed claim; operational rate keys are hashed; active bucket eviction/churn cannot reset budget.
criteria.validity_notes: No secrets or real identity data may enter evidence.

baseline.actual: Hostname was validated then passed to fetch for a second resolution; credentialed HTTP was allowed.

criteria.conditions: Local synthetic network harness; no external destinations.
criteria.evidence_method: Disposable DNS/HTTP harness with rebinding, redirect, private-address, Host/SNI, and protocol cases.
criteria.target: Validated IP is the connected IP; SNI/Host remain correct; redirects revalidate; credentialed non-loopback traffic requires HTTPS.
criteria.validity_notes: The tested connection path must be the actual adapter path, not only a helper unit test.

baseline.actual: Default client used simulationAuthHeaders and App accepted typed operator/tenant/Admin authority.

criteria.conditions: Synthetic identity provider double only; no real IdP.
criteria.evidence_method: Synthetic API/web E2E through bootstrap, token lifecycle, authorization, tenant isolation, and recovery states.
criteria.target: Login, expiry, 401/re-auth, tenant switching, and roles derive from trusted identity; simulation authority is restricted to explicit test profile.
criteria.validity_notes: UI hiding is not authorization evidence.

baseline.actual: Entrypoint consumed before equivalent preflight; ready event came after loop; health depended on sweep.

criteria.evidence_method: Start the homolog worker against disposable dependencies, inject DB/queue/exporter/sweep failures, and inspect readiness/health/telemetry.
criteria.source: apps/worker homolog entrypoint and health; A20-F06
criteria.target: Real worker path performs DB/RLS preflight, emits readiness before consumption, and reports dependency/sweep failures independently.
criteria.validity_notes: Process behavior, not only helper seams, is required.

baseline.actual: Hotspots and composition seams remain insufficiently proven by integrated evidence.

criteria.evidence_method: Run characterization tests, inspect ownership/dependency boundaries, and inject exporter failure through the operational path.
criteria.target: Telemetry is exportable and exporter failure is safe; incremental extractions preserve behavior with explicit ownership.
criteria.validity_notes: Structural improvement must have an observable test or ownership consequence.

baseline.actual: Prior restore compared table count only and load/restore were in-memory or narrow.

criteria.conditions: Disposable PostgreSQL; productive RPO/RTO remains outside scope.
criteria.evidence_method: Run disposable PostgreSQL workload, backup/restore, migration recovery, and application reconciliation with repeat counts and raw artifacts.
criteria.target: Repeated declared load plus restore/rollback validates content, checksums/rows, roles, grants, RLS, outbox, journals, and application reads.
criteria.validity_notes: A backup command alone cannot prove restore integrity.

baseline.actual: Chromium-only evidence left auth recovery, tenant-specific data, reduced motion, and Firefox/WebKit unresolved.

criteria.conditions: Synthetic browser environment; no production users.
criteria.evidence_method: Run synthetic E2E and accessibility checks for each declared browser and inspect screenshots/results.
criteria.source: frontend UX, accessibility, and browser support; A20-F14
criteria.target: Declared browser matrix passes authz, tenant data, recovery, focus, contrast, reduced motion, and WCAG checks; unsupported browsers are explicit.
criteria.validity_notes: Unsupported browsers must not be overclaimed.

baseline.actual: Historical image and supporting evidence were not all bound to the same candidate manifest/run.

criteria.evidence_method: Run the qualification catalog under Node 22, inspect image/runtime/source digests and offline manifest verification.
criteria.source: CI, runtime, image, SBOM, licenses, and certification; A20-F12
criteria.target: Node 22, image digest, build/smoke, SBOM, licenses, load/restore, and certification are bound to one verifiable run/candidate.
criteria.validity_notes: Node 24 is diagnostic only; Node 22 evidence is required.

baseline.actual: Historical and current evidence scope/ownership had drift and the prior critic packet lacked complete provenance.

criteria.conditions: No external signoff is implied; production remains NO_GO.
criteria.evidence_method: Run documentation/link/manifest checks and inspect the candidate-bound evidence graph and immutable historical references.
criteria.target: Authority, freshness, historical immutability, candidate scope, packet/session identity, and evidence hashes are explicit and consistent.
criteria.validity_notes: Documentation changes require a new candidate; historical certificate is never rebound.

baseline.actual: No AUD20 candidate or run exists yet.

criteria.conditions: Local synthetic disposable only; stop at WAITING_HUMAN_APPROVAL and production NO_GO.
criteria.evidence_method: Run the complete Node 22 catalog, create a new candidate/run, bind all evidence, commission a fresh read-only I1 critic, verify pre/post fingerprints, and record the separate human approval boundary.
criteria.target: A new candidate passes AUD20-001 through AUD20-017 on the same artifact, is frozen, receives a fresh I1 critique without repair during the window, and has a MATCH post-critic sentinel.
criteria.validity_notes: A technical pass never grants G20-5 or production authority.

goal: Remediate AUD20-001 through AUD20-018 in local synthetic disposable scope, qualify a new candidate, and stop at WAITING_HUMAN_APPROVAL with production NO_GO.

sources.location: current user authorization and AUD20 continuation request

sources.license_notes: Repository plan, backlog, and audit findings.
